article.title: Vocabulary quiz: pick the correct synonym
article.description: Quiz format: 'Which word is closest in meaning to HAPPY? a) Content  b) Furious  c) Exhausted  d) Confused' Answer: a) Content. Teaching point: 'content' means satisfied/happy with one's situation — a common IELTS/vocabulary-test synonym pairing.
article.content: Quiz format: 'Which word is closest in meaning to HAPPY? a) Content  b) Furious  c) Exhausted  d) Confused' Answer: a) Content. Teaching point: 'content' means satisfied/happy with one's situation — a common IELTS/vocabulary-test synonym pairing.

generated.caption:
Ever feel happy but need a slightly different word? Today's quiz shows 'content' is a perfect synonym! It means you're satisfied with your situation. For example: 'I'm very content with my new job.' This word often appears in vocabulary tests like IELTS.

Save this tip and follow us for daily English!
generated.script: Happy ka ek bahut common synonym jismein log aksar confuse ho jaate hain. Pata hai kaun sa? Woh word hai content. Content ka matlab hota hai jab aap apni current situation se satisfied ho ya happy ho. Basically, jab aap apne haalaaton se khush ho. Ye IELTS aur vocabulary tests mein bahut common synonym pairing hai. Toh ab jab koi puche 'Are you happy?', aap confidently bol sakte ho 'I am content!'. Ab hua na clear? Comment mein batao aapko ye pata tha ya nahi! Aur aise hi useful English tips ke liye The English Vault ko follow karo!

slides.body: When you're 'content,' it means you feel satisfied and pleased with your current situation, often with a sense of quiet happiness rather than excitement. It's a perfect synonym for 'happy' in many contexts, making it a valuable word often tested in vocabulary quizzes and exams like IELTS. For instance, 'She felt content watching the sunset from her balcony.' This word helps express a deeper, more settled sense of well-being.
